issues.reason: The oblique rule pins the head to the preposition actually used and states outright that `During` renders only the word "during", so "in the final phase" must take the surface head `In`.

"Raid" is an event-denoting noun, so its witness is an eventuality and `Location` is exactly the event-side head for it (the ban is on `Location` over a THING), and in the uncovered attributive-place-name territory the reviewer itself flags, the locative content of "the London raids" is true of the sentence and well-typed.

With no associated event and no "-est" dimension available — the reviewer's own gap — `(Ordinal sk_phase_1 last phase)` is improvisation whose atom is true (this phase ranks last on the ordering of phases) and well-typed, which the calibration line makes acceptable; it under-specifies the operation rather than asserting anything false.

gaps_confirmed: attributive proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ("the London raids") — the naming rules cover only a name that names its own referent, and the compound-kind rules give no route for a place-name modifier
coordinated modifiers sharing one head noun ("a cocaine and money laundering ring") — coordination is defined for clauses, VPs and NPs, not for two modifiers of one nominal
an ordinal on a stage noun ("the final phase") with neither an associated event nor an "-est" dimension to fill `Ordinal`'s scale slot
new_gaps: a group whose members are eventualities (`GroupOf sk_raid_1 raid`): nothing states whether event-side heads (`Location`, `Time`) may attach to such a group witness
a phase/stage PP ("in the final phase of a two-year operation") — nothing says whether it is temporal nesting, an interval, or a preposition-named oblique
repair_summary: Replaced the `During` head on "in the final phase" with the surface preposition head `In` (proof name updated to launch_in accordingly); every other atom kept verbatim.
notes: The bounded count, the duration `Measure`, the reduced-relative "investigating" and the group-only launch predication all hold up; the two refuted issues are the same uncovered-construction improvisation the calibration line protects.
